# SpringConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SpringConstraint")`

A spring between two attachments. It pulls them together when they are farther apart than `FreeLength` and pushes them apart when they are closer, with a force that grows with the distance. Use it for a suspension, a bouncy bridge or a door that closes by itself.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)` | read/write | The color of the line the spring is drawn as. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The force that resists the spring's change of length, in newton seconds per meter. At 0 the spring bounces indefinitely; a high value makes it settle slowly. |
| `FreeLength` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The length at which the spring applies no force, in meters. |
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `MinLength` and `MaxLength` are hard limits on the spring's length. |
| `MaxLength` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The longest the spring can be, in meters. |
| `MinLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The shortest the spring can be, in meters. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `100` | read/write | The force the spring applies for each meter it is away from `FreeLength`, in newtons per meter. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The thickness of the line the spring is drawn as, in meters. |
